_meta.description: Tier 2 — Administration Import & Migration navigation per REQ-AIM-010. Adds the 'Import & migration' menu with the import wizard, batch list, batch detail (reports + reversal action via lifecycleActions), and the mapping review grid, bound to the canonical ImportBatch / ImportMapping schemas. The multi-step wizard (upload via NC Files picker → profile selection → mapping review → validation findings → dry-run report → post) is described as a sequence over the batch detail + mapping grid; the single-screen wizard host is the ImportWizard custom component.

pages.title: Import wizard
pages._note: A single-screen host for a six-step migration run (choose the auditfile in Nextcloud Files, source package, mapping review, validation findings, dry run, post) whose steps each run a different lifecycle transition on one ImportBatch. `type: form` submits one object once and its config.steps only split that object's own fields into pages: it cannot run validate, dry-run and post between steps, nor hold progress on validation findings. Resolved against registry.js kind:page (src/views/import/ImportWizard.vue, platform-administration-import task 2.1). The same flow stays operable through ImportBatches / ImportMappings / ImportBatchDetail.

config._note: MASTER archetype (native CnDetailPage). An import batch is a staged administration migration (XAF + companion CSVs → opening journal, open items, relations) that owns its ImportMapping review rows (FK batchReference) as the actual mapping-review surface, so it renders via relatedCollections rather than a bespoke object-list widget. KEY: the prop is `relatedCollections` — a `relatedLists` block is not a prop on any Cn page component, lands in $attrs and renders nothing. TOKEN: `@objectId` — ImportMapping.batchReference is documented as "UUID or slug" and ImportBatch exposes no flat batch-reference field, so the UUID is the only value reachable from a filter token. The source XAF/CSV files are metadata on sourceFiles (Nextcloud Files references, linked not stored) so the Documents sidebar tab surfaces them via openregister-file-references. The status field drives a fail-closed lifecycle (draft → parsing → staged → mapping → validated|validation_failed → dry_run_complete → posting → posted|posting_failed → reversed), so the lifecycle toolbar is preserved via lifecycleActions. Audit trail lives in the canonical sidebarProps audit tab.

headerActions.label: Continue in the wizard
headerActions.description: Open this batch in the import wizard, at the step it has reached, to validate it, run the dry run or post it.

config._note: CONFIG archetype (native CnDetailPage). An import mapping ties one source-system account code to a target GL account for a batch — a configuration row a bookkeeper confirms (rgs-auto/profile-default pre-confirmed, manual needs confirmation, unmapped blocks validation). It has no child records of its own and no independent lifecycle state machine (ImportMapping carries no x-openregister-lifecycle), so per the config archetype the page is fields + audit trail only — no relatedLists, no lifecycleActions, no files.
